blocks.text: Few national elections carry as much environmental weight as Brazil’s presidential race. And this one is being watched from far beyond the country’s boundaries. Home to the largest section of the Amazon rainforest, Brazil is guardian of a carbon sink of vital importance, making the country’s conservation policies globally relevant. Environmentalists have already voiced alarm at Flávio Bolsonaro
